findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/state.js::enotempty fallback leaves a ledger-less dir that rundirsnewestfirst still lists
findings.title: ENOTEMPTY fallback leaves a ledger-less dir that runDirsNewestFirst still lists
findings.action: No change; leave the non-empty dir and name it on stderr, as the spec edge case requires
findings.disposition_rationale: Only reachable when withFileLock's best-effort unlink fails or another writer puts content in the dir; the spec accepts this edge case (non-recursive rmdir, one stderr line naming the dir). Ledger-reading callers of runDirsNewestFirst skip it; resolveParked finds no park.md in it.
